sections.text_helper: Section 4.4.2 "Independent data register (CRC_IDR)" in chapter 4 (CRC calculation unit), RM0008 Rev 21, page 65.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x04
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reserved
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 General-purpose 8-bit data register bits
Can be used as a temporary storage location for one byte.
This register is not affected by CRC resets generated by the RESET bit in the CRC_CR
register.
